text:
marta_sales: Heads-up on BigBank POC demo now — they hit a 404 when calling embeddings from eu-west and are asking for a short Dedicated trial quote + HSM/KMS details. Can we triage?

rachel_se: on it. what exact error did they paste?

marta_sales: they sent: ```Error: model \"embed-legacy-1\" not found in region eu-west-1
request_id=pb-77f8
status=404```

jordan_ops: 404 like that = model variant removed from eu-west catalog (we deprecated some legacy embed variants last week). Did they pin region or model in config?

marta_sales: they pinned model name in their config file and set region explicit to eu-west-1. Using our Python SDK v1.9.

emma_devex: quick migration suggestion: move to `embed-semantic-v3` or remove the regional pin so routing picks nearest compatible model. Example snippet for python: ```from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-semantic-v3', input=[\"doc1\",\"doc2\"])``` note: dims unchanged, small tokenization differences.

jordan_ops: confirm: v3 dims = 1536, backward compatible for similarity. Only caveat: some very old normalization differences could change nearest-neighbor order slightly. Recommend running their eval set once.

ben_oncall: also saw they hammered batches earlier and saw intermittent 429s. From logs: ```429 rate_limited -> bucket:cust-1122 route:/v1/embeddings create concurrent=48 burst=120```

rachel_se: they wanted committed numbers for trial: 300 embed/sec sustained, occasional 2k/min chat peaks. Can we size?

jordan_ops: sizing note: 300 embed/sec sustained ~ 2x small-gpu baseline; recommend a single dedicated node with burst autoscale + reserved burst capacity for the peak. I'll open an infra reservation ticket.

billing-bot: Trials with reserved capacity and applied credits need approval from finance. Please include expected commit length (2 weeks) and minimal $/month baseline.

marta_sales: security questions from BigBank: do we support importing customer-managed keys for Private? HSM-backed keys? What about TLS termination?

security-bot: short answers: yes on CMK imports for Private (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault supported), HSM-backed keys via enterprise Private package (bring-your-HSM or HSM-peering). TLS: for Private, customer manages edge TLS termination; for Dedicated we support mTLS and customer-cert pinning. See internal KMS doc: https://redwood.internal/security/kms.

jordan_ops: created INF-4599 to reserve eu-west test node + enable trial burst. tags: bigbank-poc, sales, trial.

ben_oncall: once INF-4599 ready I can temporarily raise the soft rate cap for cust-1122 for 72 hours and monitor. Will watch for 5xx or memory pressure.

emma_devex: I'll send a small migration harness and a sample eval script they can run to compare embed-legacy-1 vs embed-semantic-v3. Include a note to reindex if they rely on exact vector ids.

marta_sales: great. Action list: (1) Emma send migration harness & migration caveats (2) Jordan finish infra ticket (done) (3) Ben lift cap once node up (4) Rachel gather trial sizing + I'll loop finance for credits. Also I'll provide an official compatibility note we can attach.

billing-bot: finance contact: finance@redwood.internal. They'll need draft quote + trial addendum.

marta_sales: I'll draft the quote and share. Thanks team, will update BigBank after Emma's test results.

rachel_se: FYI, suggest we offer 1000 free test credits to cover migration re-runs during the trial.

jordan_ops: noted — I'll make node available by EOD tomorrow.

marta_sales: closing thread once eval passes on embed-semantic-v3. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
